say:20:1321791015:0.source_cn: “……如果真到了那一天，替我向母亲问声好，好吗？请她原...

say:21:1321791016:0.source_cn: “……谁让这个世界这么有趣呢，父亲！我还有好多想吃想玩...

say:22:1321791017:0.text: "As your daughter, I forbid you to come see me! Promise me you'll live for countless more years, as long as the eternal snow on Whiteridge Mountain and as enduring as my love for you!"
